title: The Battle of Kulikovo
description: September 1380. Dmitry Donskoy's coalition of Russian principalities meets Mamai's Golden Horde army on the upper Don. The player commands the Russian centre, which must absorb the Horde's cavalry assault long enough for the ambush regiment concealed in the treeline to strike its flank.

issues_found: Mamai is titled 'Khan' in the narration; he was a beklarbek/emir who ruled through puppet khans and never held the title himself, a small but avoidable factual slip.

A KEEP anchors the Russian position, implying permanent fortification on what was an open field encampment between the Don and Nepryadva; a palisade/watch tower or tent cluster alone would have been closer.

Player 1's mounted arm (10 Cavaliers plus 8 Knights) is heavier than the Russian host's proportion of mounted druzhina relative to its large infantry levy; the 12 Spearmen understate the foot-heavy centre the player is told to hold.
Victory fires on Mamai's death, whereas Mamai in fact fled the field and was killed later in Kaffa; the encoded goal substitutes killing the commander for breaking his army after the flank attack.

The ambush regiment is triggered by a scripted timer and a single PATROL rather than by the player's own endurance, so the historically decisive timing decision by Bobrok-Volynsky is taken out of the player's hands.
